AdminPages.peopleLede: Everyone known to your church. Add a visitor, update a contact, or tap a name for the full profile.
AdminPages.sendJobsLede: SMS and WhatsApp blasts to members.
AdminPages.templatesLede: Reusable messages for SMS, WhatsApp, and email.
AdminPages.churchProfileLede: Organisation details, locale, and module access.
AdminPages.membershipsLede: A snapshot of the people you serve — visitors becoming active members, and anyone paused.
AdminPages.joinRequestsLede: Approve to attach the person to your church and issue a member PIN for Sign in.
AdminPages.ministriesLede: Teams, departments, and life groups that organise service in your church.
AdminPages.leadershipLede: Positions and reporting relationships. Appointments do not grant system access — assign roles separately under Church profile.
AdminPages.eventsLede: Schedule Sunday services and gatherings, attach a poster, and open any card for the full-size view.
AdminPages.attendanceLede: How many showed up to recent services, and who among your leaders might need a nudge.
AdminPages.absencesLede: People who let the church know they'd be away — so follow-up lists don't flag them.
AdminPages.projectsLede: Time-bound efforts with an optional fundraising goal — building works, outreach, missions. Members can express interest to volunteer.
AdminPages.financeLede: A calm overview of giving — offerings, funds, and open pledges. Drill in for the full ledger.
AdminPages.offeringsLede: Record Sunday collections and other gifts. Post them to the ledger when you're ready.
AdminPages.fundsLede: How giving is categorised — general offerings, designated projects, and restricted funds.
AdminPages.pledgesLede: Promises of giving and how much has been received so far. Follow up kindly when things drift.
AdminPages.expensesLede: Record a spend as a draft, submit it, and a second person approves it in Approvals. Approved expenses with accounts set are posted to the ledger automatically.
AdminPages.journalsLede: Double-entry ledger. Drafts can be edited by finance; posting requires balanced lines in an open year. Posted entries are corrected by reversing, never deleting.
AdminPages.budgetsLede: Planned spending and income per account. Compare against actuals in the Budget vs actual report.
AdminPages.accountsLede: The chart of accounts every journal, offering and expense posts to, and the financial years they fall in.
AdminPages.approvalsLede: Second-person sign-off for spending and church-wide announcements. You can't decide a request you submitted yourself.
AdminPages.reportsLede: Live leadership, ministry and finance reports. Save a report with its filters to rerun it in one click.
AdminPages.minutesLede: A searchable record of what leadership and ministry teams decided.
AdminPages.delegationsLede: Hand some of your permissions to another leader for a set period — for example while you travel. Every use is audited.
AdminPages.exportsLede: Download data as CSV to open in Excel. You only see exports your role allows; every export is recorded in the audit log.
AdminPages.auditLogLede: High-impact actions — approvals, money, roles, exports — recorded with who did them. Sensitive values are removed.
AdminPages.membershipApplicationsLede: People asking to become members. Approving activates their membership; rejecting keeps them as a visitor.
AdminPages.appointmentRequestsLede: Unit leaders propose someone for a position; a leader with appointment rights approves (creating the appointment) or rejects it.
